sources.title: High-Yield Prebiotic Polymerization of 2′,3′-Cyclic Nucleotides under Wet–Dry Cycling
sources.supported_scope: Activated cyclic nucleotide wet-dry polymerization produces a biased length/composition distribution. The resulting population is not an endogenous recursive witness.
sources.implementation_consequence_and_limit: Characterize actual generated output, absolute amount and terminal chemistry; never substitute composition-normalized or selected oligomers.
sources.verification: Primary publisher or archived primary-paper indexed text; not an independent replication.

sources.title: Minimal RNA self-reproduction discovered from a random pool of oligomers
sources.supported_scope: A characterized 20-nt RNA supports template-directed assembly from two supplied 10-nt substrates; complex formation and activation losses limit amplification.
sources.implementation_consequence_and_limit: Segregated benchmark. The audit rate 0.0011/h is retained only as an illustrative sensitivity input, not a qualified rate for generated founders; the exact coefficient was not re-extracted from the indexed primary excerpt during this build.
sources.verification: Primary publisher or archived primary-paper indexed text; not an independent replication.

sources.title: High-Fidelity RNA Copying via 2′,3′-Cyclic Phosphate Ligation
sources.supported_scope: Cyclic-phosphate ligation is supported under a specified alkaline, low-salt experimental window.
sources.implementation_consequence_and_limit: Actual output must work in the downstream copying/reset cycle. Long ligation product alone is not recursive lineage replacement.
sources.verification: Primary publisher or archived primary-paper indexed text; not an independent replication.

sources.title: A small polymerase ribozyme that can synthesize itself and its complementary strand
sources.supported_scope: QT45 is a selected small polymerase benchmark with substrate, yield and environmental constraints.
sources.implementation_consequence_and_limit: Optional physically segregated benchmark only; no admission into endogenous founder ancestry and no autonomous route-closure conclusion.
sources.verification: Primary publisher or archived primary-paper indexed text; not an independent replication.

sources.title: Icelandic Hot Springs as a Prebiotic Analog: Wet–Dry Cycling Effects on the Stability of Nucleotides and Nucleic Acids
sources.supported_scope: Different hot-spring waters have different effects on nucleotide and short-RNA survival. Stable monomer behavior does not establish stable polymers.
sources.implementation_consequence_and_limit: Measure degradation in the actual matrix, alongside production and recovery; do not treat a generic habitat name as compatibility evidence.
sources.verification: Primary publisher or archived primary-paper indexed text; not an independent replication.

sources.title: Selection for growth drives the emergence of genetic heredity in protocells
sources.supported_scope: An individual-based protocell model couples growth/monomer supply to inherited information under specified assumptions.
sources.implementation_consequence_and_limit: Candidate growth-information feedback; not a universal order-of-events theorem or measured integration.
sources.verification: Primary publisher or archived primary-paper indexed text; not an independent replication.

sources.title: Harvesting chemical power from cyclic environments
sources.supported_scope: A driven-reservoir theory gives frequency-dependent chemical power under wet-dry and reactant cycles.
sources.implementation_consequence_and_limit: Measure waveform, relaxation, work and loss rather than substitute average conditions. Predicted resonance is model-conditional.
sources.verification: Primary publisher or archived primary-paper indexed text; not an independent replication.

sources.title: A Hadean timeline for the emergence of the RNA World
sources.supported_scope: A Hadean bombardment/thermal model evaluates windows favorable to an RNA world.
sources.implementation_consequence_and_limit: Environmental prior/sensitivity input, not a measured date of abiogenesis or observation of the actual first route.
sources.verification: Primary publisher or archived primary-paper indexed text; not an independent replication.

sources.title: Functional abiotic metabolite assembly hypothesis for the early events in the origin of life
sources.supported_scope: Functional abiotic metabolite assemblies are proposed as organizers and catalysts in early chemistry.
sources.implementation_consequence_and_limit: Alternative branch for discriminating tests, not a demonstrated integrated pathway.
sources.verification: Primary publisher or archived primary-paper indexed text; not an independent replication.
